content.text: I have the three inline comments. Now I’m checking the surrounding implementation, especially the carry-forward path and transcript-path resolution helpers, to determine which comments are real issues versus noise.

I’ve confirmed one substantive regression risk in the new hook logic and one consistency bug around transcript relocation. I’m checking the post-commit state update path once more so I can rank the comments cleanly and avoid overstating the carry-forward case.

**Findings**

1. Medium: the Cursor carry-forward comment is valid. In [manual_commit_hooks.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli_worktree1/cmd/entire/cli/strategy/manual_commit_hooks.go#L2381), `HandleTurnEnd` now advances `CheckpointTranscriptStart` after any mid-turn commit if the transcript grew. That conflicts with the intentional carry-forward reset in [manual_commit_hooks.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli_worktree1/cmd/entire/cli/strategy/manual_commit_hooks.go#L2667), where `CheckpointTranscriptStart = 0` is required so the next checkpoint is self-contained. If a mid-turn commit also carried files forward, the new stop-time code overwrites that `0` and breaks the invariant the surrounding comments already document.

2. Medium: the Copilot transcript-path comment is also valid. The new code in [manual_commit_hooks.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli_worktree1/cmd/entire/cli/strategy/manual_commit_hooks.go#L2387) calls `GetTranscriptPosition(state.TranscriptPath)` directly, but other transcript readers first re-resolve the path via [resolve_transcript.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli_worktree1/cmd/entire/cli/strategy/resolve_transcript.go#L23) to handle agents that relocate transcript files mid-session. If relocation happened, this new block can silently fail to advance the offset and reintroduce the original bug for those agents.

3. Low: the Copilot test cleanup comment is reasonable. [transcript_offset_test.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli_worktree1/cmd/entire/cli/integration_test/transcript_offset_test.go#L159) computes `transcriptLinesAtCommit` and immediately discards it. It is dead code and the name is misleading because it is a byte length, not a transcript position.

**Summary**

Two comments identify real code issues; one is a cleanup nit. The carry-forward regression is the important one to fix before merge.

I’m patching the hook to respect carry-forward state and to resolve relocated transcript paths before reading positions. I’ll also remove the dead test variable and run the targeted integration test file.
The hook change is in. I’m cleaning the test nit now, then I’ll run the focused integration test file to verify the behavior still holds.

In [manual_commit_hooks.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli_worktree1/cmd/entire/cli/strategy/manual_commit_hooks.go#L2381), `HandleTurnEnd` now:

In [transcript_offset_test.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli_worktree1/cmd/entire/cli/integration_test/transcript_offset_test.go#L163), I removed the dead `transcriptLinesAtCommit` variable.
